facts.text: Tarleton requires all first-time freshman students younger than 21 years of age to live on campus for one academic year.

sources.title: Student Engagement and Success from Student Affairs
sources.quote: Tarleton supports an on-campus living requirement of: One (1) academic year for: all “First Time Freshman” students who are younger than 21 years of age, prior to the start of the first registered semester.
